text:
kevin (support): FYI incoming request from MidLake Health — they want explicit audit log retention for 7 years and SOC2 artifacts for vendor review. customer emailed PDF.
anya (product): copying details? do we have the exact questionnaire or just the ask?
kevin (support): attached PDF in email thread, I'll paste key lines: "retain audit logs with identity + request payload for 7 years; provide SOC2 Type II evidence and control narratives; data residency in eu-west-1"
sam (sales): this is a deal-breaker for them. they asked for pricing impact and whether Private deployment is required.
maria (security): 7 years is unusual for logs, that’s an archival requirement. SOC2 evidence we can provide summary + documentation but not raw logs. we need legal review for retention.
frank (eng): storing payloads for 7 years has implications: storage, redaction, encryption, searchability. we should clarify whether they need full request bodies or only headers/metadata.
kevin (support): ask sent back: they want request metadata + request/response body for auditing. they said PII is allowed if encrypted and access-controlled.
anya (product): propose triage steps: 1) Intake questionnaire from customer (specific controls they need) 2) Security feasibility + rough T-shirt estimate 3) Product decision: accept as backlog item vs recommend Private/onprem 4) Draft acceptance criteria for launch/contract. ok?
maria (security): agree. immediate blockers: retention policy, KMS rotation policy, key access for auditors, and minimum encryption-at-rest standards. we also need CLA for data processing addendum (DPA) for GDPR.
sam (sales): timeline: customer needs confirmation within 10 business days for RFP. they prefer hosted if we can meet controls vs Private.
frank (eng): quick feasibility: we can implement configurable retention tiers per customer, with cold archival to encrypted S3 Glacier. ballpark: 1-2 sprints infra + 1 sprint QA for a minimal safe path (metadata + hashed payloads). full payload retention with searchable index is bigger: add 2 more sprints.
anya (product): acceptance criteria draft: 
- we can toggle per-customer log retention window up to 7 years
- stored artifacts encrypted with customer-specific KMS or tenant key
- access logs + auditability for Redwood staff and auditor requests
- redaction option for PII fields or hashed storage if requested
- export path to provide SOC2 artifact package (control narratives + sampled evidence)
- documented security review and legal DPA signed

maria (security): add: retention deletion workflow with proof of deletion for audits, and retention clock anchored to event timestamps.
kevin (support): customer also asked for GDPR data subject rights mapping. they want assurance that we can delete PII on request even if logs retained.
maria (security): that'll require selective redaction: retain logs but remove PII fields. doable but more work. note: for encrypted full payloads, deletion = delete encryption key; need legal on whether that meets their audit expectations.
anya (product): decision options to present to customer: 
A) Hosted + add-on: support up to 7y retention for metadata + redacted payloads, SOC2 package, DPA. Recommended if acceptable.
B) Private deployment: full payloads retained + dedicated KMS and direct auditor access. Higher cost and longer lead time.
C) No-go: if they require unredacted searchable payloads stored in plaintext or access to raw keys, we decline.

sam (sales): please provide number: rough delta in pricing for A vs B so I can take to them.
frank (eng): rough cost calc: storage + retrieval + snapshotting + added SRE ops. for 7y retention of avg 10GB/day = ~25TB, infra + ops ~ $Xk/mo. I'll make a quick spreadsheet.
anya (product): next actions: 
- kevin: get the exact questionnaire fields and upload to this thread (due EOD)
- maria: draft security feasibility notes and required controls matrix (48h)
- frank: ballpark cost + infra implementation notes (48h)
- anya: draft acceptance criteria and customer-facing options + recommended path (72h)

kevin (support): uploaded questionnaire link: https://files.redwood/midlake-questionnaire.pdf 
sec-bot: Reminder: add DPA template from legal repo — https://legal.redwood/dpa-template
maria (security): noted. I'll loop in legal after initial feasibility.
sam (sales): thanks team — will stall customer for 72h and flag urgency. :handshake:
anya (product): filing this as product backlog candidate if feasibility OK. I'll create a ticket with the acceptance criteria and link here.
kevin (support): thanks everyone. I'll follow up with MidLake and push their questionnaire.
frank (eng): btw quick config snippet idea for per-tenant retention: 
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "midlake-123",
  "retention_days": 2555,
  "redact_fields": ["ssn","dob","medical_id"],
  "kms_key": "arn:aws:kms:eu:123:key/abc",
  "archive_tier": "glacier"
}
```

anya (product): perfect, frank. that'll help scope. closing the loop here once tickets created. :rocket:
